name: Stationfall

categories.label: PC Agenda points
categories.hint: Points from your revealed PC's Agenda (rows with + need the preceding row, e.g. Escape).

categories.label: Bonus Character points
categories.hint: Friend: 1 per Friend icon if it Escaped. Grudge: 1 per Grudge icon if it was not Live at Stationfall. None if you Schrodinger Revealed.

categories.label: Unused own Bribe
categories.hint: 1 point if you still hold your unused Bribe.

categories.label: Others' Bribes on your PC
categories.labelVi: Bribe của người khác trên PC
categories.hint: 1 point per other player's Bribe on your PC's card.

categories.label: Influence cubes over limit
categories.hint: Lose 1 point per Influence cube outside your pool over your PC's Influence Limit.

categories.label: Guilty at end (cannot win)
categories.hint: Guilty players cannot win unless their Escaped PC delivered Evidence to Authorities.

categories.label: Your cubes in the Betrayal box

tiebreakers.description: Fewest cubes in the Betrayal box
If still tied, share the victory.

winCondition: Highest total points among players who are not Guilty. 6-8 players: two winners; 9 players: three winners; team games: add teammates' scores.

endCondition.description: 10-14 Minutes depending on player count, or earlier Stationfall trigger

notes: family: hidden-agenda. 2-player uses two Secret Identities each (scores combined; Influence Limits penalised separately; cannot win if either is Guilty). Character-specific Agenda values come from Character Dossiers, so entered as a number. Rules text from RulesPal transcription; original PDF not retrieved.
